artisanat.title: Handmade furniture
artisanat.subtitle: Wood and steel furniture, drawn and welded in the workshop in Saumur, France. Nothing in stock: the steel is cut when you order. Firm prices, delivery and assembly included.
artisanat.altBandeauLumiere: Corner of a light ceiling: the powder-coated aluminium frame and the stretched membrane
artisanat.craftBandBody: Every piece leaves our own workshop: the wood is picked board by board, the steel is TIG-welded then powder-coated, and final assembly is done by hand. No industrial runs — your furniture is made for you, to order.
artisanat.faqDeliveryQ: What are the making and delivery times?
artisanat.faqDeliveryA: Each piece is made to order. The time is shown on the piece's own page, on the “Lead time” line: from 3 to 12 weeks depending on the model — a chair leaves sooner than a staircase. Then comes delivery across mainland France with assembly included; we propose a precise slot as soon as your piece is ready.
artisanat.faqCareQ: How do I care for a wood & steel piece?
artisanat.faqCareA: A soft dry cloth day to day. For oiled wood, re-apply hardwax oil once a year; scratches sand out lightly. Powder-coated steel wipes clean with a damp sponge — no abrasives.
artisanat.deliveryBody: We deliver anywhere in mainland France. Your furniture travels under blankets, with no throw-away packaging, and we agree a precise time slot with you. Assembly on site is included: the piece is ready to use when we leave.
artisanat.delaiBody: You are ordering a piece made for you, not an item off a shelf. The production time is shown above, in the details, on the “Lead time” line: allow 3 to 12 weeks depending on the piece and the season. The exact time is confirmed when you order.
artisanat.avisNote: First projects are under way: client reviews will be published here.
artisanat.contactBody: A particular size, a specific timber, a colour outside the range? Tell us what you have in mind and we adapt.
artisanat.faqCustomA: Yes. The sizes shown are our usual formats, but the workshop works piece by piece: length, width, height, shape of the top — all of it is open. Send us your measurements and we will quote.
artisanat.faqShorterQ: Can the lead time be shorter?
artisanat.faqShorterA: Some steps cannot be rushed: drying the timber, welding, powder coating, finishing. We can sometimes bring an order forward depending on the workshop schedule — call us and we will tell you where we stand.
artisanat.faqPayA: Catalogue pieces are paid in full by card when you order, and your invoice is sent automatically. For bespoke work quoted individually (staircase, steel partition, sculpture), a 40% deposit starts production and the balance is paid on delivery. Backlit stretch ceilings, including at your own dimensions, are ordered and paid online like the rest of the shop.

apropos.title: About
apropos.histoireBody: Auboiacier is Aumercier, wood and steel in a single word. Behind the workshop there is a welder and metalworker: over five years on sites and in workshops, in France and then in Australia, with a specialist in backlit stretch ceilings. Back in Saumur, he built the workshop around those two crafts — welding steel, working solid wood — and around the light he learned out there.
apropos.savoirFaireBody: TIG, MIG-MAG and stick welding, aluminium frames mitred and fitted to the millimetre, stretched membranes, gluing and sanding of solid-wood tops. Everything happens here, from the cut to the finish. That is why a fault can be put right: we know whose hands made the piece, and we take it back.

sculptures.title: Sculptures
sculptures.tagline: One-off pieces in reclaimed steel, welded by hand.
sculptures.intro: The rearing horse is made of hundreds of steel offcuts — spanners, chains, bolts, sheet metal — welded one by one until the animal's movement appears. It is not a production item: it is an artwork.
sculptures.body: Every sculpture is designed with you: the subject, the size, the materials, the base and the place it will stand. The work is done by hand in the workshop and takes several weeks depending on the piece. They live outdoors in the rain just as well as in a hallway.
sculptures.priceBody: On request — each piece being unique, the price depends on the subject, its size and the time it takes to build.
sculptures.photoAlt: Rearing horse sculpture in reclaimed steel, welded by hand, in front of a stone house

verrieres.title: Interior steel partitions
verrieres.tagline: Slim steel, clear glass, made and fitted to measure.
verrieres.intro: A steel partition divides without closing: the kitchen stays open to the living room, light goes through, noise stops. We draw the frames as slim as possible so the glass takes up all the room.
verrieres.body: Every partition is measured at your home then welded in the workshop, in one piece whenever the room allows. You choose the number of bars, the steel finish — matt black, clear-lacquered raw steel or white — and the details: brass handles, pivot or sliding door, clear, frosted or smoked glass.
verrieres.detailBody: Solid brass handles and hinges, bolted onto the frame: they take on a patina over time, like an old door.
verrieres.priceBody: On request — the price depends on size, number of doors and finish. Allow 4 to 8 weeks between measuring and fitting.
verrieres.photoAlt: Black steel interior partition between a living room and a kitchen
verrieres.detailAlt: Solid brass handle on the steel frame of a partition
verrieres.panelTitle: Solid panels where they earn their place
verrieres.panelBody: Lower down, glass can give way to steel sheet stiffened by a cross brace: the bottom of the door takes the knocks, and the partition gains character.

cgv.title: Terms and conditions of sale
cgv.intro: These terms govern sales made on auboiacier.fr. They are accepted by the customer before any payment.

sections.title: 1. The seller
sections.body: Auboiacier, an artisan metal and wood workshop based in Saumur, Maine-et-Loire, France. Full company details and registration numbers: see the legal notice.

sections.title: 2. Products
sections.body: Pieces are made by hand, to order, in our workshop. Wood and steel are living materials: slight variations in tone, grain and finish are normal and are not defects.

sections.title: 3. Prices and VAT
sections.body: Prices are shown in euros and are the total amount payable: no tax and no fee is added at payment. The applicable price is the one displayed at the time of the order. For catalogue pieces, delivery in mainland France and on-site assembly are included. The workshop's VAT treatment is stated on the invoice.

sections.title: 4. Ordering and payment
sections.body: Catalogue pieces are paid in full by card at the time of the order. Payment is handled by our provider Stripe: no card data is stored by Auboiacier. For bespoke work quoted individually, a 40% deposit starts production and the balance is paid on delivery.

sections.title: 5. Production times
sections.body:
Every piece is made to order: nothing is held in stock. The production time is shown on each piece's own page, on the “Lead time” line — from 3 to 12 weeks depending on the model, the finishes chosen and the season. For bespoke work, the time is stated on the quote.

That time starts on payment (or on the deposit) and is confirmed to you in writing when you order. Should we exceed it, we tell you: you may then ask us to deliver within a further reasonable period and, if that period is missed, cancel the order and be refunded under article 9.

sections.title: 6. Delivery
sections.body: Delivery is made in mainland France, on a date agreed with the customer. It is the customer's responsibility to check that the piece can be brought to the installation site (access, stairs, doorways).

sections.title: 7. Right of withdrawal
sections.body:
Under article L221-28 3° of the French Consumer Code, the fourteen-day right of withdrawal does not apply to goods made to the consumer's specifications or clearly personalised. As our pieces are made to order with dimensions, timbers and finishes chosen by the customer, they fall under this exception and cannot be returned or exchanged, unless we expressly agree.

If a piece were sold to you without personalisation and without being built to your measurements, the fourteen-day right of withdrawal would apply as usual: an email would be enough, and the refund would be made under article 9.

sections.title: 8. Warranties
sections.body:
All our pieces are covered by the legal warranty of conformity (two years from delivery) and by the legal warranty against hidden defects (two years from the discovery of the defect). In plain terms: if the piece does not match what was agreed, or if a hidden defect appears, repair, replacement, a price reduction or a refund is at our expense.

The full wording of those rights is reproduced word for word in the official box at the end of these terms. Normal wear, and damage caused by misuse, unsuitable maintenance or modification of the piece, are excluded.

sections.title: 9. Claims, returns and refunds
sections.body:
Any claim should be sent to us by email, with photographs where possible, as soon as the piece arrives. We reply within 48 working hours and agree the next step with you: repair, replacement, price reduction or refund.

Any refund due is paid no later than fourteen days after the right to it arises (withdrawal accepted, order cancelled, sale rescinded). It is made to the payment method used for the order — usually back to your card through Stripe — at no cost to you.

sections.title: 10. Personal data
sections.body:
We only collect what is needed to handle your order: name, email, phone, city and delivery address, order details and amount. Payment is processed by Stripe Payments Europe, emails are delivered by Resend, the site is hosted by Vercel; these providers act on our behalf. cgv.garantieTitle: Legal warranty of conformity and hidden defects — official wording
cgv.garantieIntro: The text below is the wording required by French law. It is reproduced as it stands, unchanged.
cgv.garantieBody:
The consumer has two years from delivery of the goods to obtain the benefit of the legal warranty of conformity should a lack of conformity appear. During that period, the consumer need only establish that the lack of conformity exists, not the date on which it appeared.

The legal warranty of conformity entitles the consumer to repair or replacement of the goods within thirty days of the request, free of charge and without major inconvenience.

If the goods are repaired under the legal warranty of conformity, the consumer benefits from a six-month extension of the original warranty.

If the consumer asks for the goods to be repaired but the seller insists on replacement, the legal warranty of conformity is renewed for two years from the date of replacement.

The consumer may obtain a reduction in the purchase price and keep the goods, or end the contract and be refunded in full against return of the goods, if:
1. The trader refuses to repair or replace the goods;
2. The repair or replacement takes place after a period of thirty days;
3. The repair or replacement causes major inconvenience to the consumer, in particular where the consumer definitively bears the cost of taking back or removing the non-conforming goods, or bears the cost of installing the repaired or replacement goods;
4. The lack of conformity persists despite the seller's unsuccessful attempt to bring the goods into conformity.

The consumer is also entitled to a reduction in the price of the goods or to rescission of the contract where the lack of conformity is so serious that an immediate price reduction or rescission is justified. The consumer is then not required to ask for repair or replacement first.

The consumer is not entitled to rescission of the sale where the lack of conformity is minor.

Any period during which the goods are unavailable for repair or replacement suspends the remaining warranty period until the repaired goods are delivered.

The rights set out above arise from articles L. 217-1 to L. 217-32 of the French Consumer Code.

A seller who obstructs in bad faith the operation of the legal warranty of conformity incurs a civil fine of up to 300,000 euros, which may be raised to 10% of average annual turnover (article L. 241-5 of the French Consumer Code).

The consumer also benefits from the legal warranty against hidden defects under articles 1641 to 1649 of the French Civil Code, for two years from the discovery of the defect. That warranty gives a right to a price reduction if the goods are kept, or to a full refund against return of the goods.

confidentialite.title: Privacy policy
confidentialite.intro: This page explains what information the auboiacier.fr website collects about you, why, who receives it, how long we keep it and how to exercise your rights. It applies to quote and contact requests, appointment requests and orders placed online.

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible for your data
sections.body:
The data controller is Auboiacier, a metalwork studio in Saumur (49400, Maine-et-Loire, France), represented by Quentin Aumercier. The business's full details (registered name, legal form, SIRET, registered address) appear below where provided, and in the legal notice.

For any question about your data: auboiacier@gmail.com. The studio has no data protection officer: its size and activity do not require one.

sections.title: 2. The data we collect, depending on what you do
sections.body:
You browse the site without filling anything in: we collect no personal data. Your cart is stored in your browser only (section 8). The host's technical logs record your IP address and browser type for a few days at most, to run and protect the site.

You request a quote or contact us: name, email address, phone (optional), town, type of project, your message, and the photos or plans you attach (JPG, PNG or PDF). The language you were browsing in is sent with the request, so we can reply in that language.

You request a measuring appointment: the same information, plus the half-day you would like. If you book and pay for the visit online, your postcode is used to calculate the travel price, and the booking is handled as an order.

You order online: the delivery town (asked in the cart), the order details (pieces, options, dimensions, notes you add), then, on Stripe's payment page: name, email, phone, delivery address and card details. Your card details are entered at Stripe and never pass through our site.

We collect nothing else: no customer account, no password, no profile, no sensitive data. Please do not include any in the free-text field of your messages.

sections.title: 3. Why, and on what legal basis
sections.body:
Answering your quote, contact or appointment request and sending you an acknowledgement: steps taken at your request prior to a possible contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Processing your order, taking payment, organising manufacture, delivery or the visit, sending you the confirmation and invoice, handling warranties and after-sales service: performance of the contract (Article 6(1)(b)).

Keeping invoices and accounting records: legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c); French Commercial Code).

Protecting the site against abuse (limit on submissions per IP address, anti-bot field, technical logs) and measuring traffic without identifying anyone: legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f)), with no impact on your rights and freedoms.

We do no marketing: no newsletter, no promotional follow-up, no sale or sharing of your data for marketing purposes. If we ever offered a newsletter, it would rely on your consent, freely given and revocable at any time.

sections.title: 4. Who receives your data
sections.body:
Your data is read by the craftsman himself, and processed by the providers below, who act on our behalf, on our instructions and only for the purposes stated:

— Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd. (Dublin, Ireland): payment page, payment collection, invoice, refunds, storage of the contact details and delivery address linked to the order. Stripe also processes some data on its own account (fraud prevention, regulatory obligations), under its own privacy policy: stripe.com/privacy.

— Resend, Inc. (United States): delivery of our emails (acknowledgement, order confirmation, order sheet to the studio). The message passes through Resend for as long as it takes to deliver.

— Vercel Inc. (United States): hosting of the site and running of the forms. Vercel sees the IP address and technical logs; if sending an order sheet to the studio fails, the order reference, email and postcode are written to its logs for a few days so that the order is not lost.

— Google (Gmail, Google Ireland Ltd.): our mailbox, where your requests and order sheets arrive.

— Base Adresse Nationale (French public service, api-adresse.data.gouv.fr): only your postcode, sent by our server, to calculate the distance for a measuring visit. No other information goes with it.

We do not sell, rent or pass on your data to anyone. It may be disclosed to an authority where the law requires it.

sections.title: 5. Transfers outside the European Union
sections.body:
Stripe Payments Europe is established in Ireland; it may transfer data to its parent company Stripe, Inc. (United States) under Stripe's Binding Corporate Rules, approved by the European authorities, and standard contractual clauses.

Resend and Vercel are US companies: the data they process may be hosted or accessed in the United States. These transfers are governed by data processing agreements including the standard contractual clauses adopted by the European Commission and, for providers certified under it, by the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. Where the provider allows it, we choose execution in Europe (site functions in Paris, emails sent from Ireland).

Google Ireland may transfer data to Google LLC (United States) under the same safeguards.

You can obtain a copy of the applicable safeguards by writing to auboiacier@gmail.com.

sections.title: 6. How long we keep it
sections.body:
Quote, contact or appointment request without an order: three years after our last exchange, then deletion. Attached photos and plans follow the same rule.

Orders and paid appointments: order and invoice data are kept for ten years from the end of the financial year, as French accounting law requires (Article L123-22 of the Commercial Code). During the legal warranty period (two years after delivery), they also serve after-sales service.

Technical logs and anti-abuse counters: from ten minutes to a few days, at the host.

Cart: in your browser only, until you empty it, the order is paid, or you clear the site's data in your browser.

Stripe keeps, on its side, what its own legal obligations require (see its privacy policy).

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body:
At any time you may ask to see the data we hold about you, to correct it, to have it erased, to restrict its use, to object to processing based on our legitimate interest, and to receive the data you gave us in a machine-readable file (portability). You may also tell us what to do with your data after your death (a right under French law).

An email to auboiacier@gmail.com is enough, preferably from the address used for your request or order. We reply within one month. If there is serious doubt about your identity, we may ask for a means of verification, without requiring a copy of an ID document if another means suffices.

Erasure cannot cover invoices and data the law requires us to keep (section 6): we will tell you so and keep them apart from any other use.

If you are not satisfied with our reply, you may lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority, the CNIL: www.cnil.fr/en/plaintes, or by post to CNIL, 3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07, France. If you live in another EU country, you may also contact your local authority.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and browser storage
sections.body:
This site sets no cookies and embeds no advertising tracker, no social network button, no third-party video or map.

It uses a single local storage entry in your browser ("auboiacier-panier-v1") to remember the contents of your cart from one page to the next. This storage is strictly necessary for the service you request and is exempt from consent (Article 82 of the French Data Protection Act). It stays on your device, is not sent to us as such, and you can clear it by emptying the cart or clearing the site's data in your browser.

Audience measurement: this site uses Vercel Web Analytics to count visits and page views. The tool sets no cookies and reads nothing on your device. It does not identify visitors: your IP address and browser name are used only to build an anonymous fingerprint, renewed every day, and are not stored. The data collected (page viewed, country, device type, browser, referring site) is processed on our behalf by Vercel Inc., which hosts the site, on the basis of our legitimate interest in knowing how the site is used (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR), and is not combined with any other data. No consent is required for this measurement; you can block it with a content blocker without affecting the site.

The payment page is Stripe's (checkout.stripe.com): Stripe sets its own cookies there, needed for payment and fraud prevention, governed by its cookie policy (stripe.com/legal/cookies-policy).

sections.title: 9. Security
sections.body:
The site is served over HTTPS only. Card details are entered and stored at Stripe, a PCI DSS certified provider; we have no access to them. Access to our mailbox, to Stripe and to the host is protected by password and two-step verification. Form attachments are checked (photo or PDF only) before being forwarded, and the number of submissions per address is limited.

In the event of a data breach likely to affect you, we would inform you and the CNIL within the time limits set by the GDPR.

sections.title: 10. Updates
sections.body: This policy may change if the site or our providers change. The date at the top of the page shows the version in force; a significant change will be announced on the site.

sections.body: Angers, Cholet, Tours, and more widely the Maine-et-Loire (49), Indre-et-Loire (37), Deux-Sèvres (79) and Vienne (86): we travel there regularly. Travel is priced into the quote, so you know what it costs before you commit.

sections.title: Anywhere in mainland France
sections.body: Catalogue pieces are delivered anywhere in mainland France with assembly included: they travel under blankets, with no throw-away packaging, and we agree a time slot with you. For an installation further from home (backlit stretch ceiling, steel partition, staircase), write to us: we look at the job and the driving time, and we tell you honestly whether it works.

sections.title: How a project runs
sections.body:
1. You describe your project, through the form or by email.
2. For bespoke work, we come and measure up — or we work from your drawings if you are far away.
3. You receive a written quote, travel and installation included.
4. Production starts once the deposit is paid.
5. We deliver, we install, and we only leave once the piece is in use.

zone.ctaTitle: Your town is not on the list?
zone.ctaBody: Write to us anyway: tell us where you are and what you want built, and we will give you a straight answer.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The questions we are asked most often, answered plainly. If yours is not here, write to us.

items.q: How long will my piece take?
items.a: Everything is made to order: nothing is held in stock. The time is shown on each piece's own page, on the “Lead time” line, and runs from 3 to 12 weeks depending on the model — a chair leaves sooner than a staircase. The exact time is confirmed to you in writing when you order.

items.q: Can the lead time be shorter?
items.a: Some steps cannot be rushed: drying the timber, welding, powder coating, finishing. We can sometimes bring an order forward depending on the workshop schedule — write to us and we will tell you where we stand.

The prices shown in the shop are firm: what you see is what you pay, delivery in mainland France and assembly included. They come from workshop hours and materials, with no middleman or reseller. For bespoke work (staircase, steel partition, sculpture), the price depends on size and finishes: it is quoted individually, free of charge.

Yes. The sizes shown are our usual formats, but the workshop works piece by piece: length, width, height, shape of the top — all of it is open. On tables and light panels, a calculator gives you the price for your own dimensions, in millimetres. For anything else, send us your measurements and we will quote.

We deliver anywhere in mainland France. Your furniture travels under blankets, with no throw-away packaging, and we agree a precise time slot with you. Assembly on site is included: the piece is ready to use when we leave.

The workshop is in Saumur, in the Maine-et-Loire. We regularly travel across the 49, the 37, the Deux-Sèvres and the Vienne to measure up and install, and we deliver furniture anywhere in mainland France. The detail is on the Where we work page.

items.q: How do I care for a wood & steel piece?
items.a: A soft dry cloth day to day. For oiled wood, re-apply hardwax oil once a year; scratches sand out lightly. Powder-coated steel wipes clean with a damp sponge — no abrasives.

Catalogue pieces are paid in full by card when you order, and your invoice is sent automatically. For bespoke work quoted individually (staircase, steel partition, sculpture), a 40% deposit starts production and the balance is paid on delivery. Backlit stretch ceilings, including at your own dimensions, are ordered and paid online like the rest of the shop.

items.q: Can I cancel or return an order?
items.a: Our pieces are built to your dimensions and your finishes: French law excludes the fourteen-day right of withdrawal for goods of that kind, so we cannot take them back once production has started. The legal warranty of conformity and the warranty against hidden defects do apply in full, however: if the piece does not match what was agreed, or has a hidden defect, we repair it, replace it or refund it. The detail is in our terms of sale.

items.q: How is a backlit stretch ceiling installed?
items.a: The aluminium frame is fixed to your existing ceiling, then the fabric is stretched: no demolition, no dust, and the install usually takes a day. The largest single panel is 400 × 300 cm; beyond that we butt several boxes together to cover a whole ceiling.
